snippet.title: Indefinite: Interrogation - Gameplay Demo
snippet.description:
Get on Android (free): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.me.brandlibel.indefinite 
Get on iOS: https://itunes.apple.com/US/app/id1039602724?mt=8
Official Website: http://brandlibel.me/indefinite

After a mysterious incident devastated the world, you've been taken in for interrogation. Make one mistake and you will be found guilty.
Indefinite is a text game containing frantic memory-based action.
